premise: When the rain comes Ladybug and Snail squeeze under Mushroom's cap, and then Frog — who loves the rain — squeezes in too, just to be with everyone; it's a squash, but Mushroom drinks up the rain and grows a little.
inspiration: The Mitten (Ukrainian folk), where more and more animals squeeze into one shelter; turned: the shelter grows instead of bursting.
lesson: There is always room for one more friend.
learning: Mushrooms pop up and grow fast after rain.

en-US.title: Mushroom Grows in the Rain
en-US.text: {canvas:rain 0.7} {sfx:rain} [softly] Pitter-patter, pitter-patter. Rain was falling on the meadow. {ladybug:enter} Ladybug hurried to the red {mushroom:enter} mushroom {ladybug:go under mushroom} and tucked in under her cap. {mushroom:face happy} [warmly] "Come in!" said Mushroom. Slowly, slowly, {snail:enter} Snail came crawling. "Room for me?" {mushroom:live nod} "Of course!" {snail:go under mushroom} In he squeezed. Over in the pond, {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Frog was splashing. {frog:live jump} {sfx:splash} Splish, splash, splosh! [excited] "I LOVE the rain!" But under the cap, Ladybug and Snail were giggling together. {frog:face sad} Frog stopped. [sad] Splashing alone wasn't much fun. {frog:go under mushroom} So she squeezed in too. {ladybug:face surprised} Squish! {snail:live hide hold} Snail tucked into his shell to make room. "Too many!" said Ladybug. But Mushroom drank up the rain… {mushroom:glow} {mushroom:live grow} and grew, just a little. "Room for everyone!" said Mushroom. {frog:face happy} {ladybug:face happy} [laughs] So they giggled, all squashed together, until {canvas:rain stop} the rain stopped. {canvas:sunshine} Out came the sun. {snail:live hide resume} Out peeked Snail. {ladybug:go back} Out came Ladybug. {frog:go back} Out hopped Frog. [happily] And there stood Mushroom in the sunshine, just a little bit taller.

es-ES.title: Bajo el sombrero de Seta
es-ES.text: {canvas:rain 0.7} {sfx:rain} [softly] Plic, ploc, plic, ploc. Llovía sobre el prado. {ladybug:enter} Mariquita corrió a la {mushroom:enter} seta roja {ladybug:go under mushroom} y se metió debajo de su sombrero. {mushroom:face happy} [warmly] —¡Pasa, pasa! —dijo Seta. Despacito, despacito, llegó {snail:enter} Caracol. —¿Hay sitio para mí? {mushroom:live nod} —¡Claro que sí! {snail:go under mushroom} Y se metió, apretadito. En la charca, {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Rana chapoteaba. {frog:live jump} {sfx:splash} ¡Chof, chof, chof! [excited] —¡Me ENCANTA la lluvia! Pero debajo del sombrero, Mariquita y Caracol se reían juntos. {frog:face sad} Rana se quedó quieta. [sad] Chapotear sola no tenía gracia. {frog:go under mushroom} Así que se metió también. {ladybug:face surprised} ¡Qué apretujón! {snail:live hide hold} Caracol se escondió en su concha para hacer sitio. —¡No cabemos! —dijo Mariquita. Pero Seta se bebió la lluvia… {mushroom:glow} {mushroom:live grow} y creció un poquito. —¡Ya cabemos todos! —dijo Seta. {frog:face happy} {ladybug:face happy} [laughs] Y allí se quedaron, riendo y apretujados, hasta que {canvas:rain stop} dejó de llover. {canvas:sunshine} Salió el sol. {snail:live hide resume} Caracol asomó la cabeza. {ladybug:go back} Salió Mariquita. {frog:go back} Salió Rana de un brinco. [happily] Y allí estaba Seta, al sol, un poquito más alta que antes.

rain.prompt: gentle rain pattering on grass and big leaves, realistic field recording

splash.prompt: a small frog splashing in a shallow pond, three light quick splashes, realistic
